artworks.title: Sir Walter Raleigh
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man facing forward with his head turned slightly to his left. He has a mustache, a beard, high cheekbones, short wavy hair combed back, and is dressed in an elaborate garment typical of the Elizabethan era with a high ruffled collar. He is holding a staff or baton in his right hand resting on a globe. The background is textured, with horizontal lines portraying books on the upper right side and a circular emblem or shield below with a zigzag pattern. The inscription at the top reads "TAM MARTI, QUAM MERCURIO," and the caption at the bottom identifies the subject as "The true Effigies of y Hon: S Walter Rawleigh Knight."

artworks.title: John Selden
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing forward. He has sharp, defined facial features, deep-set eyes, and a serious expression. His long, wavy hair falls past his shoulders with a fringe covering his forehead. The man wears a dark, formal robe over a white, collared shirt. Around him is an oval frame with decorative ribbons on each side. The background inside the oval is dark, contrasting against the man and the lower portion of the image includes text stating "Johannes Seldenus" and printing information.

artworks.title: John Selden
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait of a man with long, wavy hair, a high-collared shirt, and a dark coat. He is positioned in a semi-frontal pose, looking slightly to the side. The backdrop features an oval frame enclosed in a rectangular border. The inscription includes the name "Johannes Seldenus" and details about the engraving being printed for Thomas Lee in 1677.

artworks.title: Sir Philip Sidney
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body with a refined expression, arched eyebrows, wide eyes, a straight nose, a small beard and mustache. He has short, wavy hair combed back, and is wearing ornate armor with a ruff collar. The background has a textured pattern and the portrait is framed in an oval with an inscription above and below labeling the man as "PHILIPPVS SIDNEIVS" along with other text details and the artist's signature.

artworks.title: William Winstanley, Poet and Compiler
artworks.description: The image features an engraving with a bust of a man's upper body on a column in the center, flanked by two obelisks. The bust depicts a stern-looking man with aged features, wavy hair, and a laurel wreath on his head. He is draped in a robe, and above him, an angelic figure with wings holds wreaths inscribed with the word "Immortality." At the base of the obelisks, skeletons are reclined, resting upon labeled pedestals with names such as Homer, Ovid, Ennius, Chaucer on the left, and Pindar, Horace, Virgil, Cowley on the right. The background has cloud patterns and the ground has small vegetation, creating a somber yet majestic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Title Page to Epistolae Hoephanae, by James Howel
artworks.artist: Frederik Hendrik van den Hove after William Marshall
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various historical and allegorical figures with inscriptions. The central section features the title "Epistolæ Ho Elianæ Familiar Letters Domestic & Forren Historical. Political. Phylosophical." To the left and right are portraits of Roman figures, C.C. Cæsar, M. Tul. Cicero, M. Avrelius, and L. Annæus Seneca in octagonal frames. Above, two allegorical figures labeled "Phylosophia" and "Historia" are depicted. In the lower central portrait, a figure with the phrase "Sub mole resurgo" surrounds them. The layout forms a composition combining classical antiquity, allegory, and authorial identity.

artworks.title: Thomas Cromwell, Earl of Essex
artworks.artist: John Fillian after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a bust-length portrait of Thomas Cromwell. He is seated, facing slightly left with a serious expression. His features include a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a stern mouth. He wears a soft cap and a fur-lined cloak. He holds a ring in one hand and rests his hands together in front. The background is a dark pattern, and there is a table in front of him with a closed book, papers, a quill, and an inkpot. The image includes a label with his name above his head and text below detailing his titles and significant life events.

artworks.title: Lancelot Andrewes, Bishop of Winchester
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a man with a high forehead, thin eyebrows, a mustache, and a neatly trimmed beard. He wears a cap and a clerical robe with a ruffed collar, and a large outer garment. Below the portrait is an inscription. The background is an oval frame with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Isaac Barrow, D.D., Divine and Mathematician
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait from the chest up. He is facing slightly to the viewer's left with a direct gaze. The man has curly hair that falls to shoulder length, framing his face. His facial features include a prominent nose and a slight smile. He is wearing a dark robe with vertical stripes and a large white collar. The background features an ornate oval frame with decorative elements. Below the portrait, there is a crest-like emblem with crossed swords and lilies.

artworks.title: Ralph Bathurst, Dean of Wells
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man in 17th-century attire. He is shown within an ornate oval frame, facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. The man has wavy, shoulder-length dark hair and distinct facial features. He is dressed in a dark academic gown over a white collar. The oval frame is embellished with decorative elements like ribbons and a coat of arms at the bottom. The background features detailed engravings.

artworks.title: Ralph Bathurst, Dean of Wells and President of Trinity College, Oxford
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man displayed in an oval frame. He is positioned facing slightly to his left, with wavy, shoulder-length hair, a well-defined nose, and slightly arched eyebrows. He is wearing a formal outfit with wide sleeves and a white collar. The frame has decorative ribbon-like elements and below it is a coat of arms with intricate designs. The background is crosshatched, and the surrounding area has a detailed architectural border.

artworks.title: Sir Henry Blount, Traveller
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of an older man's body. He is turned slightly to his left and looking at the viewer. The man has facial lines, curly shoulder-length hair, and wears a formal historical European outfit with decorative buttons. The portrait is in an oval frame with intricate engravings and a Latin inscription on top.

artworks.title: Sir Henry Blount, Traveller
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a man in a head-and-shoulders portrait. He is facing the viewer directly in an oval frame, with sharp facial features including a furrowed brow and slightly downturned mouth. The man has long, curly hair and is dressed in formal attire with a high collar. The background features an intricately designed frame with Latin text "LOQUENDUM CUM VULGO SENTIENDUM CUM SAPIENTIBUS," ornate scrollwork, and a heraldic shield with abstract patterns at the bottom.

artworks.title: Charles II
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man showing his upper body. He is positioned straight, facing slightly to his left while making direct eye contact with the viewer. The man has long, wavy dark hair that reaches his shoulders and features a prominent nose and mustache. He is wearing elaborate armor that appears to be metallic with a dark, patterned garment visible underneath. Around his neck, he wears a white lace-like cravat and a medallion suspended on a chain. The portrait is framed with a circular wreath that surrounds the figure. The background is a crosshatched texture with a Latin inscription written at the top. Below the image, there is a decorative element displaying a shield and some text.

artworks.title: James Stanley, Seventh Earl of Derby
artworks.artist: David Loggan after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: An engraving of a man named Mr. John Carter is shown in a waist-up portrait within an oval frame. He is seated, facing slightly to the right, with his hands placed together. He has a trimmed beard and hair, and wears formal attire with a cap. On a nearby table is an open book, an ink pot with a quill, and an hourglass. The background features lined shading within the oval frame and Latin text surrounds the image within the frame.

artworks.title: Thomas Fuller, Divine and Historian
artworks.description: The image depicts a man shown from the waist up, facing slightly to his left with a solemn expression. He has wavy, shoulder-length dark hair, a prominent nose, and a strong jawline. The man is dressed in a dark robe with a white collar. Surrounding him is an intricately designed oval border with text. Below the portrait is an engraved epitaph with elegant calligraphy. The background is plain, emphasizing the subject within a rectangular frame with ornate detailing.

artworks.title: John Goodhand Holt
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a person from the upper body down to the waist. The person faces slightly to the right, with their head turned towards the viewer. They have delicate facial features, wavy shoulder-length hair, and wear a garment with an ornate lace collar, a vest, and puffed sleeves. The figure is surrounded by a decorative oval border with embellishments above the head and heraldic crests in the top corners. Below the portrait is a poetic inscription in cursive handwriting with small embellishments, set against a textured background within the oval border.

artworks.title: John Goodhand Holt
artworks.description: The image shows a young individual with curly hair and a delicate expression wearing a period outfit. They are facing slightly right with arms crossed. The background features an oval frame with decorative elements and an inscription at the bottom. No jewelry is visible.

artworks.title: Arthur Jackson, Ejected Divine
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man with a full beard, mustache, and intense gaze. He is shown wearing a formal cloak with a large white collar and a black robe. His head is turned towards the viewer, partially obscured by a cap. The background features a dark, cross-hatched pattern enclosed in an oval, with decorative framing at the bottom. The scrollwork at the bottom contains the inscription "Arthur Jackson."

artworks.title: Mother Louse, Keeper of an Ale-House called  Louse Hall, near Oxford
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman in profile. She has prominent facial features with visible wrinkles. She wears a conical hat fastened beneath her chin, a dark dress with a pleated collar, and an apron tied at the waist. She holds a mug in each hand. In the background, there are trees and a thatched cottage with chimneys. Above her, there is a decorative crest with a three-mug design and a banner with the words “THREE LIESE PAS SANT.” The lower portion of the image contains a block of text in verse form.

artworks.title: Henry More, Platonist and Theologian
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man. He is facing slightly to the right, with long, curly hair falling to his shoulders. The man wears a formal gown with a white collar. The background is ornate, with an oval frame and scrollwork. Below the portrait is a decorative base with a coat of arms, including a helmet atop a shield with stars, and the inscription "Effigies HENRICI MORI Cantabrigiensis S. T. D. Etat. 65," identifying the subject as Henry More, aged 65, associated with Cambridge.

artworks.title: Edward Reynolds, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man facing forward with a slight turn to his right. He has defined facial features, including a furrowed brow, a prominent nose, and a short white beard with a distinctive mustache. His white hair is partially covered by a cap that fits tightly on his head. He wears a dark robe with a high, wide, neatly folded white collar and puffed sleeves. An oval border surrounds him with text, and below the image is text in an artistic style resembling a scroll or banner. The background within the oval consists of a pattern of lines.

artworks.title: John Sparrow, Mystic
artworks.description: The image features an upper-body portrait of a man. He has shoulder-length dark hair and distinct facial features including arched eyebrows. He is dressed in formal attire, holding a quill over a sheet of paper on a table with a closed book and an inkwell. In the background, there is a coat of arms on the left and a chart on the right, set on a textured wall.

artworks.title: John Wallis, Mathematician
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait depicting the upper body of a man identified as Johannes Wallis. He has middle-length graying hair and wears a cap. His facial features include a straight nose and prominent cheeks. He wears a dark robe with a white clerical collar. The portrait is framed by intricate decorative designs and a coat of arms below it.
